component.name: Phone Controllers
component.summary: Turn phones into a wheel and pedals

description.p: Phone Controllers turns phones into a steering wheel, pedals, a gear lever and buttons for games and driving simulators. Phones open a web page, with no app to install, and the PC gets a joystick that games, Steam and Proton see like a real wheel.

ul.li: Drag the wheel, or hold the phone like a wheel and steer with it
Analog clutch, brake and gas: slide a finger, tilt the phone, or cover its camera
A turn signal lever that cancels itself and a sequential gear lever
Force feedback: the game's steering force turns the wheel, rumble vibrates the phone
Several phones at once, for example one as the wheel and another as pedals
Pedal travel, response curves and rotation set on the PC and sent to phones live
Move, resize and remove every control on the phone

description.p: The phone needs a browser on the same network. The PC needs access to /dev/uinput.
